chemistry-m3-q2.material: Kwenziwa uvavanyo apho kwatshiswa ipowuda yekopolo emoyeni kwi-crucible ukwenza i-copper(II) oxide. Xa i-4 g yekopolo yasabela ngokupheleleyo, kwenziwa i-5 g ye-copper(II) oxide. Bungakanani ubunzima be-oxygen edibeneyo, kwaye ngumlinganiselo wobunzima bekopolo ukuya kwi-oxygen?

chemistry-m3-c.material: [Iikoefisiyenti zokusabela eziphambili] Xa igesi ye-propane (C₃H₈) isha ngokupheleleyo nge-oxygen (O₂), kwenziwa i-carbon dioxide (CO₂) kunye namanzi (H₂O). Kuphawu lwekhemikhali olulinganisiweyo C₃H₈ + a O₂ → b CO₂ + c H₂O, yintoni isixa seekoefisiyenti (a, b, c), oko kukuthi a + b + c?

chemistry-killer-09.title: I-mole
chemistry-killer-09.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-09.material: Kubushushu noxinzelelo olungatshintshiyo, iigesi A no-B zisabela ukwenza igesi C ku-$\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$. I-20 mL ye-A kunye ne-60 mL ye-B zisabela ngqo zinike i-40 mL ye-C. Ubunzima beemolekyuli ze-A bu-28 kwaye ubunzima be-B bu-2. Ingxubevange ye-100 mL ye-A no-B (ubunzima beemolekyuli obuphakathi 12.4) isabela ngokupheleleyo kubushushu noxinzelelo olufanayo. Uxinano lwengxubevange yegesi emva kokusabela lingaphi amaxesha oxinano lwengxubevange yegesi ngaphambi kokusabela?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: Kubushushu noxinzelelo olungatshintshiyo, iigesi A no-B zisabela ukwenza igesi C ku-$\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$. I-20 mL ye-A kunye ne-60 mL ye-B zisabela ngqo zinike i-40 mL ye-C. Ubunzima beemolekyuli ze-A bu-28 kwaye ubunzima be-B bu-2. Ingxubevange ye-100 mL ye-A no-B (ubunzima beemolekyuli obuphakathi 12.4) isabela ngokupheleleyo kubushushu noxinzelelo olufanayo. Uxinano lwengxubevange yegesi emva kokusabela lingaphi amaxesha oxinano lwengxubevange yegesi ngaphambi kokusabela?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Umlinganiselo womthamo A:B:C = 20:60:40 = 1:3:2, oko kukuthi $\mathrm{A + 3B \rightarrow 2C}$.
Inyathelo 2: Kwingxubevange ye-100 mL vumela A = x mL: (28x + 2(100 - x))/100 = 12.4, ngoko 26x + 200 = 1240 kwaye x = 40 mL. A = 40 mL, B = 60 mL.
Inyathelo 3: Yonke i-60 mL ye-B iyasabela, isebenzisa i-20 mL ye-A yenze i-40 mL ye-C. Emva kokusabela: A 20 mL + C 40 mL = 60 mL.
Inyathelo 4: Ubunzima buyagcinwa (khangela: ngaphambili 40 x 28 + 60 x 2 = 1240; i-C inobunzima beemolekyuli (28 + 3 x 2)/2 = 17, emva 20 x 28 + 40 x 17 = 1240). Kubushushu noxinzelelo olufanayo, uxinano = ubunzima/umthamo, ngoko emva/ngaphambili = 100/60 = 5/3.
Iimpendulo: 5/3 (a). (Ezinye ezingachanekanga: i-3/5 iphendula umlinganiselo; i-1 isebenzisa ukugcinwa kobunzima kodwa ihoya utshintsho lomthamo; i-5/4 ishiya i-40 mL ye-A ngephutha, inika iyonke ye-80 mL.)
chemistry-killer-09.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
